cells.before-full.png / before-crop.png: shadow.shadowToneLaw:'ladder' — this is the STAND-IN for what 'fineLadder' rendered as BEFORE this fix. It is not a separate re-run of the pre-fix source tree (that would need stashing/checking out inside the worktree, which AGENT-PROTOCOL forbids); it does not need to be, because the unit test's geomSignature equality (tests/unit/scene3d-shadow-tone-law.test.js, 'REGRESSION' + the pre-fix run of the new 'HEADLINE (U9)' case) already PROVES 'fineLadder' rendered byte-identical to plain 'ladder' before the fix — the alias collapse routed both through the exact same shadows.js code path (no HATCH_LAW_RECIPES entry, plain hatchRingsEvenOdd fallback).
cells.after-full.png / after-crop.png: shadow.shadowToneLaw:'fineLadder' under the CURRENT (fixed) worktree — a FOLDED id (src/config/scene3d-tone-laws.js ALIASES.fineLadder -> survivor 'ladder'). Same scene, same view as 'before'. Now dispatches through shadows.js HATCH_LAW_RECIPES.fineLadder (hatchOffset(rings, angleDeg, spacing, 0, 0.97) — a 0.97x spacing multiplier, i.e. ~3% denser rulings), not the plain 'ladder' fallback.
cells.control-penCross-full.png: shadow.shadowToneLaw:'penCross' (an ORDINARY, non-folded, OFFERED survivor id) at the same view — a sanity check that the general shadowMarkLines dispatch still works for ids untouched by this fix. penCross is 'cross' mark class, so the shadow footprint renders an obviously crosshatched texture, unlike ladder/fineLadder's single-family hatch.

what_i_saw.before_vs_after: Both crops show the shadow footprint's own hatch overlaid on the ground plane's own sparser hatch, producing a fine crosshatch-looking texture at this zoom (two independent line families at different angles/pitches, not a true crosshatch mark class). The pitch difference between 'ladder' (before) and 'fineLadder' (after) is SUBTLE by design — the roster's own recipe comment says the nudge exists so no two offered ids collide, not so every pair reads as a visually distinct texture (see shadows.js's comment above HATCH_LAW_RECIPES). At native-resolution 3x-zoomed sub-crops (checked directly, not committed as separate files) the 'after' shadow lines are visibly fractionally closer together than 'before'.
what_i_saw.numeric_confirmation: shadowPathCount: before (ladder) = 147, after (fineLadder) = 151 (+2.72%). Predicted from the 0.97x spacing multiplier: 1/0.97 - 1 = 3.09% more lines in the same footprint — 147 * 1.0309 = 151.5, matching the measured 151 almost exactly. geomSig (exact-coordinate JSON signature, the same check the unit tests use) differs between before and after: stats.json summary.afterDiffersFromBefore = true.
what_i_saw.control: control-penCross-full.png shows an obviously different, crosshatched shadow texture vs. the plain hatch in before-full.png/after-full.png (stats.json summary.controlDiffersFromBefore = true, controlShadowPathCount = 190) — confirms the dispatch mechanism itself (not just this one folded id) is intact.

honesty_note: This is a small, subtle, numerically-confirmed difference, not a dramatic new texture — that is the CORRECT and expected shape of the fix (HATCH_LAW_RECIPES.fineLadder's own recipe is a 0.97x spacing nudge, deliberately small per the roster's own design comment). The rigorous proof is the exact-coordinate geomSignature check in the unit tests (RED before the fix, GREEN after); these screenshots are the required live-app corroboration, not a substitute for it.
